messages:
Mia L: Quick design review — stage cards look crowded and the "paused" state contrast feels low. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/figma/snap1.png :eyes:
Samir: Agree, paused pill text is pretty faint. I inspected the token — it's #6B7280 on white. axe flags this as contrast fail. :warning:
Alex P: Could we try a slightly darker bg for paused states instead of changing text color? keeps hierarchy but increases contrast.
Jin H: Also noticed keyboard focus on the card is almost invisible when tabbing. focus ring is 1px and clipped by border-radius. Repro: Tab through the rollout list.
design-bot: Accessibility check result: paused label contrast 2.8:1; >=4.5:1 required for normal text (WCAG AA).
Mia L: Hmm. Two asks then: stronger visual for paused + clearer focus state. Also copy: currently button says "Pause canary" — does that read clearly?
Samir: "Pause canary" is concise but could be ambiguous to PMs. What about "Pause rollout — canary 10%"? explicit and contextual.
Alex P: Love explicit copy, but UI space is tight in the card. Maybe abbreviated label on the card, full text in tooltip/flyout.
Jin H: For SRs, add an aria-label on the action: `aria-label="Pause rollout (canary: 10%)"` so screen readers get full context.
Mia L: Good call. Also want to avoid surfacing rollback inline in the card — feels too destructive. Thoughts?
Samir: Keep rollback in the details flyout. Inline actions = pause/adjust traffic only. Rollback requires modal + keyboard trap + typed confirm.
Alex P: Agree. For paused visual, propose: darker muted bg + subtle 1px separator + slightly bolder label (600).
Jin H: And update focus to be more visible. Example CSS suggestion:
```
.focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-500); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }
.card--paused { background: var(--bg-muted-3); font-weight: 600; }
```
Samir: I'll swap the token from `--text-muted-2` to `--text-muted-3` in the style PR and add the focus rules.
Mia L: Microcopy options: 1) "Pause canary" 2) "Pause rollout — canary 10%" 3) "Pause (canary)" — which do we prefer for the compact card?
Alex P: Option 3 fits visually but option 2 is most clear for logs/screenshots. Could show 3 in card and 2 in tooltip/aria.
Jin H: I'll add an automated a11y test that asserts contrast >= 4.5 and verifies `aria-label` presence for action buttons.
Samir: One more: the paused state needs a visible indicator in the timeline mini-heatmap — currently it's just a dim dot. Make it a striped pattern or add an icon so colour-only isn't the only signal.
Mia L: Nice — patterned indicator plus text should cover color-blind users. Add a small pause icon next to percent.
Alex P: I'll update the figma frames: card (compact), card (expanded), flyout details. Posting links when ready.
Mia L: Thanks — can design drop a quick prototype with the new BG + focus + icon by EOD? I'll then run keyboard and screen-reader pass tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Samir: On it, creating PR after design sign-off.
Jin H: I'll track e2e tickets and attach axe report once the change lands.
Mia L: Perfect. Follow-up: I'll post final copy and a short checklist for QA in this thread. :eyes:
